svg.title: GC content in mitochondrial chromosome windows
svg.desc: Seventeen windows for each species, plotted at their physical midpoint. Final windows have 569,299 and596 bases. GC excludes N. Lines connect neighboring summaries, not aligned positions across species.

g.text: One point per window: 1,000 bases, except each shorter final window.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--theme-a9bccb, #a9bccb)

g.text: Final windows: human 569 bp, mouse 299 bp, zebrafish 596 bp (larger markers).

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: var(--theme-a9bccb, #a9bccb)

g.text: GC = 100 x (G + C) / (A + C + G + T). Positions are not aligned between species.
